method.source: Public YouTube channel pages and visible comments
method.selection: Selected recent videos from three corroborated adult Bolivian creators; comments are not a random or complete sample
method.language: Spanish detection probability at least 0.7 and four or more words
method.sentimentModel: pysentimiento/robertuito en ONNX: sentiment, emotion, irony
method.interpretation: Automated labels describe captured comments only; they do not represent all followers or Bolivian public opinion
method.privacy: No commenter names, identifiers or comment text are published
